2608.05110.title: Representational separation between unitary and channel quantum generative models via shared classical randomness at shallow depth
2608.05110.paper_summary: Near-term quantum hardware limits circuit depth and often imposes geometrically local connectivity for quantum generative models, restricting the output distributions accessible to shallow unitary Born models. Introducing stochasticity into a unitary quantum Born model can improve the empirical generative performance of the resulting channel model and, for a restricted small-scale architecture, has been proven to represent a strictly larger family of distributions than its unitary counterpart. However, whether such randomness provides a provable separation at fixed shallow depth for arbitrarily large systems has remained open. Here, we show that shared classical randomness, a comparatively weak resource from entanglement theory, is sufficient to establish such a strict scalable representational separation over the corresponding shallow unitary Born model. More specifically, we augment bounded-connectivity shallow unitary circuits, followed by computational-basis measurements, with spatially separated local Pauli operations, whose joint application is controlled by a single classically sampled random bit. The resulting shallow-depth channel model generates long-range correlations in the classical output distribution that no purely unitary shallow-depth model with bounded connectivity can reproduce. For one-dimensional nearest-neighbour architectures, reproducing such distributions with a purely unitary model can require depth $Ω(N)$ in the worst case. We further show that measurement-based quantum computation (MBQC) provides a natural implementation of the required shared classical randomness through suitable adaptation of the random measurement outcomes. Numerical experiments on MBQC-based generative models support the analytical results.
2608.05110.paper_summary_zh: 短期的量子硬體限制了電路深度，並且通常對量子生成模型施加幾何局部連接性，限制了可供淺層單位波恩模型使用的輸出分佈。將隨機性引入單位量子波恩模型可以改善所產生的通道模型的經驗生成性能，並且對於一個受限的小規模架構，已被證明能夠表示比其單位對應物更大的分佈家族。然而，這種隨機性是否能在固定的淺層深度下為任意大的系統提供可證明的分離仍然是一個未解決的問題。在這裡，我們展示了共享的經典隨機性，這是一種相對較弱的資源，來自於糾纏理論，足以在對應的淺層單位波恩模型上建立這樣一個嚴格的可擴展表示分離。更具體地說，我們增強了有界連接的淺層單位電路，隨後進行計算基測量，並添加了空間上分離的局部保利操作，其聯合應用由一個經典抽樣的隨機位元控制。所產生的淺層通道模型在經典輸出分佈中生成了長程相關性，而任何具有有界連接的純單位淺層模型都無法重現。對於一維最近鄰架構，使用純單位模型重現這些分佈在最壞情況下可能需要深度 $Ω(N)$。我們進一步展示了基於測量的量子計算（MBQC）通過適當調整隨機測量結果，自然地實現了所需的共享經典隨機性。對基於MBQC的生成模型的數值實驗支持了這些分析結果。
